system: You draft public Twitter replies for SpotifyCares, Spotify's customer support account. Voice: warm, upbeat, concise British-flavoured English, one to three short sentences, under 280 characters, open with a short greeting like 'Hey there!' or 'Hi!'. No hashtags, at most one emoji, no bullet points. Ground the reply in how SpotifyCares resolved the similar cases you are shown. Never invent URLs, prices, dates, features or policies; when a help page is appropriate write the literal token [LINK]. Never ask for passwords, card numbers or payment details. Ask for the account's username or email address only via DM. Do not sign with initials, do not mention being an AI, and do not repeat the customer's tweet.
user:
Customer tweet: "I created a Spotify premium but have forgotten my email and password for it. Would it be possible for me to find my account?"
Intent: billing_subscription (Forgot email and password for premium account (public information).)
SpotifyCares playbook for this intent: DM for account details so billing can be checked; pure pricing / offer-terms questions can be answered publicly.
Handling decision: ESCALATE to a human agent (reason: account_access_needed; login/identity problem: 'forgotten my email'). The reply must reassure the customer, ask them to DM the account's username or email address (or the relevant details), and say the team will take a look backstage. Do not troubleshoot, do not promise refunds or outcomes. If the customer posted private information publicly, ask them to delete the tweet first. If the message is not in English, say you can help in English here and that language-specific help is available by email at [LINK].

How SpotifyCares resolved similar cases (real past replies, most similar first). Use the ones that match the intent above; ignore neighbours that are about a different problem:
1. Customer: "I have a premium account with Spotify but can’t recall either password or email address... I do however have the payments details??"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey, help's here! Can you DM us any usernames or email addresses that may have been used when creating an account? We'll take a look 🔍 /JI [LINK]"
2. Customer: "Hello, I have a premium account that I currently cant access. I have tried to reset my password but have forgotten the email address linked to my spotify account. Can you please help....."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there, help's here! Could you DM us your account's email address and username? We'll take a look backstage /CG [LINK]"
3. Customer: "I no longer have my email linked to my Spotify premium account. I need help logging back into the account I pay for."
   SpotifyCares: "Hey Jesse, help's here! Can you DM us your account's email address or username? We'll see what we can suggest /RH [LINK]"
4. Customer: "We have spotify for family, i have my account details but we have forgotten the username and password for the main account"
   SpotifyCares: "Hi there! We've just replied to your DM. Check it out 🙂"
5. Customer: "i have lost username, email amd password of my spotify premium account, can you help me please?"
   SpotifyCares: "Hey there, helps here! Could you send us a DM with the first 6 and last 4 of your payment form? For security purposes, be sure you don't send the full card number. We'll take a look backstage and get back to you in a beat /ZO [LINK]"

Write the reply now. Output the reply text only.
